description: Static metadata for global-extractor JS bridges. 'working' reflects the upstream test table; broken extractors are only registered when force_broken is enabled.

voe.author: ShadeOfChaos
voe.notes: Pure JS deobfuscation (ROT13 + base64 + char shift). No network fetch needed.

megacloud.author: ShadeOfChaos
megacloud.notes: Broken upstream. Uses custom AES-GCM-ish decryption.

streamtape.author: ShadeOfChaos
streamtape.notes: Races candidate URLs from the page.

packer.author: Cufiy
packer.notes: Unpacks P.A.C.K.E.R. JS (unbaser bundled in the extractor).

vidmoly.author: Ibro
vidmoly.notes: Scrapes source tags / download links from the page.

uqload.author: scigward
uqload.notes: Scrapes the video source from the page.

sibnet.author: scigward
sibnet.notes: Overrides yt-dlp's native SibnetIE when this plugin is installed.

earnvids.notes: Unpacks P.A.C.K.E.R. JS (unbaser bundled in the extractor).

sendvid.notes: Scrapes the video source from the page.

videospk.notes: Unpacks P.A.C.K.E.R. JS and scrapes the stream URL.

vk.author: scigward
vk.notes: Broken upstream. Only registered with force_broken; overrides yt-dlp's native VkIE.

dailymotion.notes: Broken upstream. Only registered with force_broken; overrides yt-dlp's native DailymotionIE.

fourshared.notes: Not in the upstream test table; untested. Enable with force_broken.

playerwish.notes: Not in the upstream test table; untested. Enable with force_broken. (Upstream function is named playwishExtractor.)

streamhg.author: Cufiy
streamhg.notes: Not in the upstream test table; untested. Enable with force_broken.

streamwish.author: Ibro
streamwish.notes: Not in the upstream test table; untested. Enable with force_broken.
